_comment: Open-WebUI external tool servers - version-controlled source of truth (ADR-023).
Like model-curation.json, this lives in the Open-WebUI DB (PersistentConfig
tool_server.connections), not in Helm values: TOOL_SERVER_CONNECTIONS only seeds a
`key_from` names the Secret holding the bearer key; the script fills `key` at apply
time so no secret is ever in git.
This instance has a single admin user, so that is everyone who uses it.
function_name_filter_list: mcpo serves Zimi's full toolset (~20 tools); only these
three reach the model. deep_search matters most: under function_calling legacy a model gets
ONE tool round, and deep_search returns article text, not just search snippets.
The filter matches Open-WebUI's tool NAME, which is mcpo's OpenAPI operationId
(tool_<name>_post), by suffix. A bare `deep_search` matches nothing and silently
drops every tool: the model then answers without calling Zimi at all.

info.name: Zimi
info.description: Offline Wikipedia (EN + DE) from the Zimi ZIM library. deep_search finds and reads the best articles in one call
